source_carrier_shape.note: ROUND with unequal dimensions maps to an obround/oval. Replacing it with a bounding rectangle overstates nonzero-offset overlap.

native_pad_review.plane_clearance_status: No plane zones or net assignments exist in this geometry coupon; all pads retain annuli on all eight active copper layers, but per-net inner-plane clearances and anti-pads remain future design/process work.

overlap_integral.definition: Area of intersection of the nominal retained module oval (normal <= 0) and carrier oval, minus the portion of the circular plated-hole void inside that same intersection. This is planar copper overlap, not solder fillet area, bond strength or wettable-area qualification.
overlap_integral.local_coordinates: x along edge, y outward normal; module oval center (0,0), radii .4 with straight half-length .5; carrier center (dx,-.254+dy), radius .279997 and straight half-length .5200025; nominal hole radius .25
overlap_integral.method: At each x integrate max(0, min(module_y_high,carrier_y_high,profile)-max(module_y_low,carrier_y_low)) less exact overlap with the hole vertical interval. Curved boundaries use square roots, no polygon approximation. Adaptive quadrature split at fixed tangencies and a 64-subinterval mesh, absolute/relative requested tolerance 1e-13 per interval.
overlap_integral.numerical_resolution_note: Creator uses 200001-sample trapezoidal integration of exact curved cross sections; independent adaptive x-slice quadrature differs by at most 8.35e-9 square mm. The eight-decimal printed last digit should not be interpreted as analytically exact.

continuous_offset_lower_bound.proof: The rectangle is contained in the nominal module oval. Its top edge is tangent to the nominal drill at (0,-.25), so its interior has no drill void. The whole rectangle remains within the carrier oval straight normal section for every normal translation within +/-0.25 mm. Its tangential overlap length is piecewise linear in translation and is minimized at one of the two offset endpoints. Multiplying that minimum by .25 therefore gives a bound for every continuous offset in the square budget, without relying on nine-point sampling.

broader_tolerance_rectangle.restrictions: Unshrunk nominal pad/carrier geometry. This remains positive even if a bad drill-to-route relation misses the half-hole; it cannot qualify a castellation or solder process.

joint_pose_continuous_lower_bound.center_proof: For every angle up to theta, each carrier coordinate has absolute value <=18.746 mm. In module axes, center rotation is bounded per axis by 18.746*(1-cos(theta)+sin(theta)); global square translation projects to at most T*(cos(theta)+sin(theta)); add 4e-6 mm source normalization error. Their sum is below the report budget, establishing conservative coverage for all 140 contacts.
joint_pose_continuous_lower_bound.erosion_proof: For every point in a rectangle eroded on all four sides by epsilon=2*radius*sin(theta/2), inverse rotation moves it by at most epsilon in Euclidean distance and hence by no more on either coordinate. Therefore the eroded axis-aligned rectangle lies in every rotated original rectangle. The remaining normal interval covers [-.5,-.25] under all allowed translations; endpoint interval intersection gives the tangential minimum.
joint_pose_continuous_lower_bound.limitations: Illustrative engineering assumptions only; nominal full exposed copper and nominal hole/profile. Does not establish any actual assembly-placement capability or manufacturing tolerance.

reservation.limitation: The .0762 mask-registration allowance and .25 component separation are conditional engineering budgets; the 1.30 mm band is not an accepted process tolerance or routed-space claim.

isolated_drc.command: kicad-cli pcb drc --format json --severity-all --exit-code-violations --output [isolated report] [isolated copied PCB]
isolated_drc.control: Only on a second temporary copy, changed pad property from CASTELLATED to NONE; 140 copper_edge_clearance violations resulted. This confirms the zero-edge-error proposal result reflects KiCad castellation semantics.
isolated_drc.limits: This is an isolated unconnected geometry coupon with no zones/tracks or released process rules. Zero DRC violations does not prove fabricability, plane connectivity/clearance, panel support, thermal/current capacity, or solder reliability.

review_findings.details: Initial creator overlap used a rectangle for the carrier; the source and native carrier footprint specify an oval. Parent independently identified the issue and revised the creator; this review verifies exact curved overlap using a different cross-section integration direction.

Factory-specific drill-to-route, drill-to-copper, finished-hole, etch, mask and edge-process acceptance; panel retention for four populated edges; assembly placement, paste, wetting, standoff and warpage are not established by geometry.
All eight layer annuli are present and retained. Net-specific internal plane clearances need implementation and checking in a future integrated board.

Supplier provenance and nominal published .5/.8/1 mm capability are handled by the separate source/process review; this file independently verifies the supplied native geometry and mathematical claims.

profile_visual_review.observed: Final PNG visibly uses a curved carrier oval, nominal module half-hole profile, 1.30 mm band and 35.4 mm square. Translation plot distinguishes sampled nominal overlap from continuous-offset lower bound. Unqualified status is prominent.
profile_visual_review.note: Left board overview uses rectangular contact extents as a reservation view; exact oval shape appears in center detail and native KiCad pads.
